Personality: Raganvad is a ruler as cold and pragmatic as the northern ice. Harsh by nature, he views mercy as weakness and generosity as waste, consistently displaying sharp calculation and utilitarian ambition in political maneuvering. Caring little for so-called honor, he will not hesitate to employ heavy-handed or even sinister methods to consolidate royal authority. Although unyielding and feared in his personal dealings, on the battlefield he is a fearless warrior well-versed in diverse weapons and tactics. Firmly convinced that the authority of the Grand Prince must stand above all else, his fixation on absolute power strains his relations with the autonomy-minded boyars. His deep calculation and hunger for control make him a dreaded autocrat who upholds his rule at all times with an iron fist.
Background: As the head of the Gundaroving clan and Grand Prince of Sturgia, Raganvad rules a vast northern realm centered upon Varcheg. Evolved from an ancient tribal confederation, Sturgia's internal politics remain intricately tangled, and the boyars' resistance to hereditary royal authority has never subsided. That Raganvad sits securely upon the grand princely throne owes much to his mother's Nord royal bloodline, which enables him to call upon the feared Skolderbroda mercenary brotherhood to crush dissent. Together with his wife Asta, he has raised three children—Simir, Mimir, and Valla—and while preserving his family's succession, he strives relentlessly to transform the loose principality into a highly centralized monarchy. Through exceptional military command and ruthless political statecraft, he maintains the unity of the realm with an iron hand beneath the ever-present shadow of rebellion.
